title: Identity, linearity, locality, mass/support, boundary and approximation properties from the characterization
statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0, (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0, (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for all N, N', k, A : ℝ^N →L ℝ^{N'} and k-covectors β on ℝ^{N'}, and (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for all N, k, v ∈ ℝ^N and (k+1)-covectors β on ℝ^N (exactly the type of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds), and let lpush : ∀ N N' k, (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) satisfy (CHAR) for all N, N', k, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), C^∞ maps Fs_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) with ‖DFs_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for x ∈ spt X and Fs_j → F uniformly on spt X, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and ηs_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) each equal to Fs_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X, we have X(ηs_j) → lpush N N' k F X (ω). Then: (1) lpush N N k (fun x => x) X = X for NC X; (2) lpush F (X − Y) = lpush F X − lpush F Y for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X, Y; (3) lpush F X = lpush G X for Λ-Lipschitz F, G, NC X and F = G on spt X; (4) M(lpush F X) ≤ Λ^k·M(X) and spt lpush F X ⊆ F '' spt X for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X; (5) ∂(lpush N N' (k+1) F X) = lpush N N' k F (∂X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞; (6) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X there are C^∞ Λ-Lipschitz F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) there are η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω on an open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → lpush F X (ω). (These are conjuncts (1)–(6) of the parent, verbatim.)
